nodes.label: AutoResearchClaw: Multi-Agent Autonomous Research
nodes.author: Jiaqi Liu, Shi Qiu, et al.
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent research pipeline addressing hypothesis quality (structured debate), execution robustness (self-healing with Pivot/Refine), and experience accumulation (cross-run evolution). Outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7% on ARC-Bench.

nodes.label: Discovery Phase (scoping, literature, debate)
nodes.rationale: Multi-source literature search, gap analysis, problem decomposition, multi-agent hypothesis debate (Innovator/Pragmatist/Contrarian roles), epistemic triangulation, knowledge synthesis.

nodes.label: Experimentation Phase (execution, analysis, decisions)
nodes.rationale: Cascading code generation (complexity-based dispatch), sandboxed Docker execution (3-phase network policy), Pivot/Refine decision loop, result-stage debate (Optimist/Skeptic/Methodologist), statistical testing.

nodes.label: Writing Phase (drafting, review, verification)
nodes.rationale: Outline generation, draft production, peer review, revision, four-layer citation verification, quality gates, final paper export.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Debate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Two debate panels with K=3 agents each: hypothesis-stage (Innovator/Pragmatist/Contrarian) and result-stage (Optimist/Skeptic/Methodologist). Synthesizer integrates outputs into structured artifacts with testability criteria and falsifiable hypotheses.

nodes.label: Self-Healing Execution with Pivot/Refine
nodes.rationale: Treats failure as diagnostic information. Complexity-based code dispatch (threshold τ=0.6), static validation gates, automated repair loop with three decisions: Proceed (evidence supports), Refine (weak results, sound direction), Pivot (fundamentally flawed, return to hypothesis generation).

nodes.label: Cross-Run Evolution System
nodes.rationale: Persistent lesson store with time-decayed weighting (T2=30d). Injects lessons from prior runs into all pipeline stages as prompt overlays. Converts past mistakes into reusable safeguards.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration (7 modes)
nodes.rationale: Seven intervention modes from full autonomy to step-by-step oversight. SmartPause mechanism routes decisions to researcher when system uncertainty is high. Targeted intervention at high-leverage points outperforms both full autonomy and exhaustive oversight.

nodes.label: ARC-Bench: 25-topic Experiment-Stage Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Evaluation benchmark focused on experiment stage with rubric-assisted LLM judge. AutoResearchClaw outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7%.

nodes.label: Verifiable Result Reporting & Citation Verification
nodes.rationale: Ties all reported numbers to registry of executed outputs. Four-layer citation verification pipeline prevents fabricated numbers and hallucinated citations. Read-only evaluation harness prevents generated code from redefining measurement infrastructure.

nodes.label: AutoResearchClaw: Autonomous Research Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent autonomous research system combining debate, self-healing execution, verified result reporting, cross-run evolution, and HITL collaboration to produce end-to-end research papers from idea to publication.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Debate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Three-agent debate (Innovator/Pragmatist/Contrarian for ML; domain-specialized roles for other fields) at hypothesis generation and result analysis stages to improve quality through cross-examination and critical scrutiny.

nodes.label: Self-Healing Executor
nodes.rationale: Iterative repair loop (Pivot/Refine) that diagnoses runtime failures and applies targeted fixes, enabling recovery from execution errors rather than discarding failed runs.

nodes.label: Verified Result Registry
nodes.rationale: Whitelist of all values produced by experiment runs, storing per-condition means, standard deviations, and individual seed measurements; used to verify numeric claims and prevent fabrication.

nodes.label: Citation Verification Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Four-layer pipeline (DOI resolution via CrossRef, fuzzy title matching against OpenAlex, arXiv identifier lookup, Semantic Scholar fallback) with LLM-based relevance check to classify references as Verified, Suspicious, or Hallucinated.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Intervention Modes
nodes.rationale: Seven intervention modes (Full-Auto, Gate-Only, Thorough, CoPilot, Step-by-Step, Pre-Experiment, Post-Experiment) allowing researchers to select operating point along automation spectrum; CoPilot targets six high-leverage decision points.

nodes.label: Cross-Run Evolution with Lesson Store
nodes.rationale: Persistent lesson store extracting structured lessons from repair attempts, HITL feedback, and verification results; lessons ranked by time-decayed weight to constrain subsequent runs while allowing older lessons to fade.

nodes.label: ARC-Bench: Autonomous Research Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 25-topic ML benchmark (T01–T25) plus 20-topic scientific-domain extension (10 HEP, 7 biology, 3 statistics) supporting three evaluation modes: experiment-stage, end-to-end, and scientific-domain.

nodes.label: Rubric-Assisted Strict Judge
nodes.rationale: Grades each (framework × topic) cell along three dimensions (CD:CE:RA = 25:25:50) with two independent agent reviewers; per-leaf disagreements exceeding |Δ| > 0.20 are re-adjudicated.

nodes.label: Domain-Specialized Agents
nodes.rationale: Sandboxed domain-specialized agents (HEP agent with FeynRules/MadGraph/MadAnalysis skills; biology agent with COBRApy/BiGG/flux-balance skills; statistics agent with Monte Carlo/semiparametric inference skills) enabling cross-domain coverage without per-domain engineering.

nodes.label: 23-Stage Research Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Formal pipeline with explicit contracts (JSON schemas, acceptance criteria, error-code namespaces) balancing granularity and overhead; stages organized into 8 phases (Research Scoping, Literature Discovery, Knowledge Synthesis, Experiment Design, Experiment Execution, Analysis & Decision, Paper Writing, Finalization).

nodes.label: Three-Layer Prompt Architecture
nodes.rationale: Primary layer (23 stage-specific prompts), reusable block layer (shared text fragments), and sub-prompt layer (intra-stage operations); total ~46K tokens with domain-aware selection and parity test suite.

nodes.label: Domain Detection Cascade
nodes.rationale: Three-level cascade (forced override, keyword matching against 350+ rules, LLM classification to 24 domain IDs) with generic fallback; enables cross-stage consistency without per-domain engineering.

nodes.label: Sandbox Security Model
nodes.rationale: Docker containers with three-phase network model (dependency installation, data acquisition, experiment execution with network disabled); AST security checks, module blacklist, import validation.

nodes.label: ColliderAgent Architecture (Qiu et al., 2026)
nodes.author: Qiu, Shi et al.
nodes.rationale: HEP-specific agent architecture providing FeynRules, MadGraph, and MadAnalysis skills; directly adopted by AutoResearchClaw for high-energy physics domain coverage.

nodes.label: Multiagent Debate (Du et al., 2024)
nodes.author: Du, Yilun et al.
nodes.rationale: Foundational work on improving factuality and reasoning through multiagent debate; cited as basis for AutoResearchClaw's debate mechanism.

nodes.label: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
nodes.author: Shinn, Noah et al.
nodes.rationale: Self-refinement approach through verbal reinforcement learning; related to AutoResearchClaw's iterative repair and cross-run evolution mechanisms.
